page.overview:
Who is Drawing Commission?

The is a group in . Once Link has helped the Man of Smiles and gotten the Hero's New Clothes from him, he will receive a Prize Postcard every time he helps him after that point. m. from a postbox. He will either get a letter that says that he won or that he lost.

Normally, the hero would aim for winning the contest, but if Link wins, he will simply get congratulated without any physical prize. But if he loses, he will get a consolation prize, which always is a Ship Part.

entity.description: The is a group in . Once Link has helped the Man of Smiles and gotten the Hero's New Clothes from him, he will receive a Prize Postcard every time he helps him after that point. If Link puts one of the postcards in a he will participate in a drawing contest and get a reply from the Drawing Commission after 12:00 a.m. from a postbox. He will either get a letter that says that he won or that he lost. Normally, the hero would aim for winning the contest, but if Link wins, he will simply get congratulated without any physical prize. But if he loses, he will get a consolation prize, which always is a Ship Part.
